name: Phoenix
summary: A general-purpose humanoid from Vancouver's Sanctuary AI, built around unusually dexterous hydraulically driven hands and a control system, 'Carbon', that the company frames as translating intent into action. Sanctuary emphasises fine manipulation and short task-teaching times, and has run structured pilots in retail and light manufacturing.
notable: Industry-leading hand dexterity via miniature hydraulics
Focus on rapid teaching of new manipulation tasks
